verdict.rationale: No evidence of any integration, documentation, or mention of LiveKit, Pipecat, ElevenLabs, or any voice/real-time conversation pipeline; Cognee's documented integrations are MCP clients (Claude, Cursor, Cline), Slack/GitHub/Linear/Notion/Google Drive data sources, and a REST/CLI/Python API, none of which address voice pipeline wiring or latency requirements for live conversation.
